title: Weekly crop scouting routine
category: Food growing · Pest and disease control
summary: Find small problems before they become crop-wide failures.
steps: Inspect the same route at least weekly and more often during rapid growth or outbreaks.
Check new growth, leaf undersides, stems, soil line, flowers and fruit.
Record affected crop, exact location, pattern, weather and number of plants.
Photograph or isolate a sample for identification before choosing treatment.
Recheck after any action and stop ineffective treatment rather than repeating it blindly.
